summary: Join our expert-led training course on managing real estate investment funds. Gain essential knowledge and practical skills to succeed in the real estate market
lede: Real estate investment training covers the disciplined management of fund mandates, from selecting investments through monitoring performance. For fund managers, portfolio managers, and investment professionals supporting underwriting, it provides practical ways to assess deal fit and return assumptions, manage portfolio risk and cash flow, and prepare governance and investor reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for corporate professionals across various sectors who are responsible for managing real estate investment funds. Whether you are dealing with public sector institutions, development partners, NGOs, pension funds, insurance firms, banks, or private enterprises, this training is designed to enhance your strategic management capabilities.
audience: Pension fund, insurance, and bank professionals
Risk, compliance, and internal audit professionals
modules: Deal Pipeline and Investment Strategy Execution
Underwriting and Return Drivers for Fund Decisions
Asset Management, Performance, and Value Creation
Fund Finance, Cash Flow, Liquidity, and Distributions
Risk Management and Compliance in Real Estate Funds
Stakeholder Management and Investment Committee Mastery
Exit Strategy, Timing, and Fund Closure Discipline
ESG, Impact, and Responsible Real Estate Investing
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of real estate markets and investment principles. Prior experience in fund management or real estate investments is recommended.
